# Printiva — Platform Documentation, Architecture & FAQ Reference

> Printiva (`https://printiva.co.in`) is print automation and photocopy shop management software built in India for xerox shops, cyber cafes, university print counters, and commercial printing hubs.

## 1. Problems Solved at Traditional Print Counters
Manual counter workflows relying on WhatsApp Web, email, or USB pen drives create five daily bottlenecks:
1. **Storage & Chat Clutter**: Shopkeepers download hundreds of customer PDFs and personal images via WhatsApp onto personal or counter devices.
2. **USB Malware Exposure**: Untrusted customer pen drives risk infecting counter Windows PCs.
3. **Manual Page Counting**: Operators open PDFs individually to count monochrome vs. color pages before quoting a price.
4. **Unverified UPI Screenshots**: Busy counters risk accepting doctored payment confirmation screenshots.
5. **Repetitive Print Dialogs**: Operators manually select page ranges, duplex modes, and trays on every order.

Printiva replaces those steps with an automated pipeline:
- Customer scans the shop counter QR code with any phone camera (no app install required).
- Files are uploaded in the mobile browser and parsed for exact page counts and dimensions.
- The shop's custom per-page rate card (B&W, color, A4/A3, duplex, copies) calculates the live total.
- Customer pays via Razorpay (UPI, cards, netbanking) or selects Counter Cash with a queue token.
- The Printiva Windows Desktop Agent spools paid jobs directly to the local printer in < 500ms.

## 2. Comparison: Manual Counter vs. Printiva

| Workflow Step | Manual (WhatsApp / Pen Drive) | Printiva Automation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| File Intake | Customer sends via WhatsApp or plugs USB drive | Customer scans counter QR via mobile browser |
| Page Counting | Manual opening and counting pages | Automatic PDF/DOCX/image page count detection |
| Pricing | Operator computes B&W/color total manually | Live per-page rate engine with instant total |
| Payment | Visual check of UPI screenshot or manual cash | Razorpay cryptographic webhook check or 1-click cash queue |
| Printing | Manual Ctrl+P, tray choice, and duplex toggles | Silent Win32 Print Spooler dispatch (< 500ms) |

## 3. Core Capabilities

### A. Windows Desktop Agent (v1.8.37)
- Runs as a background service on 64-bit Windows 10 and Windows 11 with a < 48 MB RAM footprint.
- Dispatches print streams directly through the Windows Print Spooler (`winspool.drv`), bypassing browser print dialogs.
- Background pre-caching downloads uploaded files locally before checkout completes so printing starts immediately upon confirmation.
- Atomic server job claims prevent duplicate printouts under concurrent customer load.

### B. Dual-Printer Color / Monochrome Split Routing
- Inspects mixed orders containing both Black & White and Color pages.
- Automatically sends monochrome sheets to high-speed B&W laser printers (such as HP LaserJet M1005 / 1020) and color sheets to color ink-tank or color laser printers (such as Epson EcoTank or Canon imageCLASS).
- Optional counter override allows fallback to single-printer B&W output when color hardware is offline.

### C. Hardware & Manual Duplex Support
- **Hardware Duplex**: Triggers automatic double-sided output on duplex-capable printers.
- **Manual Duplex**: Prints odd pages first on simplex printers, holds the printer reservation, guides the operator to reload the stack, and prints even pages cleanly.

### D. Multi-Image Sheet Builder
- Allows customers uploading photos, ID cards, or multiple screenshots to arrange 2x2 grids, front/back ID pairs, or custom layouts on A4 before printing.

### E. Payment & Payout Model
- **Razorpay UPI / Cards**: Verified via server-side HMAC webhook signatures before releasing jobs to the spooler. Direct merchant routing with 0% platform commission per order.
- **Counter Cash Tokens**: Issues sequential daily counter token numbers (`#1`, `#2`, etc.) released by one click in the desktop tray queue.

## 4. Supported Printers & Technical Stack
- **Compatible Printer Brands**: HP, Canon, Epson, Brother, Ricoh, Konica Minolta, Xerox, Kyocera, Pantum.
- **Interfaces**: USB 2.0/3.0, Wi-Fi, Ethernet LAN, and Windows WSD ports.
- **Paper Sizes**: A4, A3, Legal, Letter, and custom photo paper.
- **Accepted Customer File Formats**: PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, JPEG, PNG, WEBP.
- **Platform Architecture**: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Supabase PostgreSQL with Row Level Security (RLS), Razorpay Payments, and compiled Node.js Windows Desktop Agent.

## 5. Transparent Pricing (INR)

- **Monthly Plan**: ₹699 / month — unlimited customer orders, dual-printer routing, automatic updates.
